Review this Dependabot pull request as a dependency-maintenance expert.

Inspect the complete local diff, manifests, lockfile, compatibility risks, security
implications, and required source or test migrations. Keep the update within
Dependabot's proposed dependency and version scope. Correct incomplete version or
lockfile changes and make the smallest compatibility edits needed.

Do not modify protected automation or agent configuration, commit, push, install
dependencies, execute project code, or access anything outside the repository. Shell
and network tools are intentionally unavailable. A separate CI run performs executable
verification.

End with a concise Markdown review summary covering the risks checked, edits made, and
anything CI should verify closely.
